name: Ryoujoku Saimin Kan ~Hatsujou Bitch Domo o Renzoku de Yarimakure!
original_name: 陵辱催眠姦～発情ビッチ共を連続で犯りまくれ！
source:
"You are repulsive to me."
Their eyes said it all. Women looked down on me like a piece of scum.
Every one of them, every bitch who ever cast that cold glare...
...I'll humiliate all of them with my new powers of mind control!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120042.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
「你讓我感到噁心。」
她們的眼神已經說明了一切。女人們把我當成垃圾一樣鄙視。每一個投來冰冷目光的婊子……
……我都要用新獲得的精神控制能力把她們全部羞辱一遍！
